name: vscode-mcp-open-docs
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server & stdio bridge for reading, searching, and navigating VS Code open documents.

vscodeMcp.host.description: Loopback interface address for the local MCP WebSocket server.

vscodeMcp.port.description: WebSocket port for the MCP server.

vscodeMcp.autoOpenDocument.description: Show a document in the VS Code editor when reading it.

vscodeMcp.restrictToWorkspace.description: Reject file read/open requests outside currently open VS Code workspace folders.

vscodeMcp.authToken.description: Optional shared token required from MCP WebSocket clients (via Authorization Bearer or x-mcp-token header).

scripts.check: node --check extension.js && node --check mcp-stdio.js && node --check lib/mcp-protocol.js
